text_block_list.text:
Tis the season, and the students of<n>Tracen
Academy are in high spirits...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, ya gotta help me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll explain later! For now, we gotta<n>get movin'!

A very panicky Taiki Shuttle takes me<n>all the way to
the Miho Dormitory<n>cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama, I brought the most reliable<n>person I could
think of to help!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And that person is your trainer?! Youknow only students are allowed in thedorm!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoops... I plumb forgot. But didn'tya say you'd kill for more help?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want ya to kill anyone, so I<n>reckoned my
trainer could pitch in!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well... there's no helpin' it now. I'll<n>allow it just
this once, so please give<n>us a hand!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Since it's the holidays and all, we're<n>gonna throw a
surprise party for<n>everybody in the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Taiki asked me for permission to use<n>the cafeteria.
Once I heard why, I<n>couldn't just sit back and not
help.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But now we've got a situation on our<n>hands—this
job is way too big for the<n>two of us.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's why we need your help,<n>Trainer!

Sounds like they're trying to spread<n>some holiday
cheer with a party.

Considering Taiki's desire to make<n>everyone
happy, this is just the sort<n>of thing I'd expect her to
get mixed<n>up in.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! Thanks a million, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Then let's start plannin'! I'll man the<n>grill!

The party I suddenly find myself<n>assisting with
ends up being well<n>worth the effort.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for putting together such a<n>wonderful
party, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Grass! Havin' fun? Don't hold<n>back now, ya
hear?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everything is so delicious! Taiki,<n>you've really done
it, amiga!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I always rake in the compliments at<n>my barbeques!
My seasoning could<n>use a little work, but I'm
confident on<n>the grill!

The students all enjoy the party with<n>huge smiles
plastered on their faces.

I'm starting to see why Taiki Shuttle<n>is so fond of
making people happy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'd say that was a rip-roarin'<n>success! Ain't no
greater joy than<n>seein' everybody happy!
choice_data_list: I'm glad everyone had a good time.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Me too! And it's all thanks to you,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But did ya find time to enjoy yourself<n>too? It looked
to me like all ya did<n>was serve everybody else the
whole<n>time...
Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Sounds like your stomach is<n>beggin' for help
too, Trainer!

Come to think of it, I was so busy that<n>I didn't get
around to eating anything<n>myself.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's mosey on back to the<n>cafeteria, and I'll
fix ya up somethin'<n>special!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I don't know much about seasoning,<n>but my grillin'
skills are top-notch, so<n>eat your fill!

Taiki Shuttle and I continue the party<n>over some
plates of slightly salty<n>food.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: By the way—I've got a gift for ya,<n>Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama prepped this one with me<n>and taught me
how to season it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This'll make ya happy for sure! So<n>dig in!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My pleasure! If you're happy, I'm<n>happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And I'm happy you're my trainer<n>too... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, you have a good night, now! I<n>really
appreciate ya helpin' us out<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Make sure ya rest up! Tomorrow's<n>the
post-holiday party!

Despite her parting words sounding<n>like certain
trouble, it's definitely been<n>a holiday season to
remember.
